name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_abdominal_pain_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has abdominal pain.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of abdominal pain.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of abdominal pain.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of abdominal pain.

name: patient_has_finding_of_abdominal_pain_now@@is_main_complaint
meaning: Boolean indicating whether abdominal pain is the main complaint.
when_true: Set to true if abdominal pain is the main complaint for the patient at the current encounter.
when_false: Set to false if abdominal pain is present but is not the main complaint.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether abdominal pain is the main complaint.
